exercises.q: Match each word with its meaning (Wiktionary's definitions).
pairs: to let go, to let off
exercises.why: From Wiktionary: отча́яние — despair; отпусти́ть — to let go, to let off; отсу́тствие — lack, absence; отдава́ть — to give back, to return.

**Отойди** — отойти́ (perfective): to go away, to go aside, to move away, to move aside; (military) to withdraw, to fall back; (colloquial) to be out for a while, to go away temporarily (with the intention to come back soon); (отойти от те́мы) to digress. Wiktionary: ото- + -йти́.
exercises.context: Which prefix? The English says which word it is.

exercises.why: **отходи** — отходи́ть (imperfective): to go away, to go aside, to move away, to move aside; (military) to withdraw, to fall back; (colloquial) to go away temporarily (with the intention to come back soon); (colloquial) to come around, to come back to normal (e.g. after a shock or disease). Wiktionary: от- + ходи́ть.

exercises.q: Match each word with its meaning (Wiktionary's definitions).
pairs: to go away, to go aside, to move away, to move aside
to lead away; to take / draw aside; to take away
to rest, to relax, to have a rest
exercises.why: From Wiktionary: отходи́ть — to go away, to go aside, to move away, to move aside; отвести́ — to lead away; to take / draw aside; to take away; отдохну́ть — to rest, to relax, to have a rest; отыска́ть — to find, to track down.

**отведу** — отвести́ (perfective): to lead away; to take / draw aside; to take away; to divert; to avert, to parry; to deflect; to draw off; to ward off; to allocate, to assign. Wiktionary: от- + вести́.
exercises.context: Which prefix? The English says which word it is.
